'''Gentes''' was one of three habitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], located in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]]. 

==Description==
Gentes was orbited by one moon, [[Belsus/Legends|Belsus]]. Both of them had valuable [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet's surface was covered by [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] and swamps.

==History==
The Ugnaughts lived in primitive colonies on the planet's less-than-hospitable surface in times of peace, but Gentes was frequently raided by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. 

They were enslaved by the [[Mugaari]]<ref name="TEA" /> who [[Mugaari Space/Legends|ruled]] the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]].

After [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was constructed over the planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] took three tribes of Ugnaughts to work the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas [[Mining/Legends|mines]] there.

Around [[1002 BBY]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] operated a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Academy (Gentes)|academy]] on the world that specialized in the training of [[Sith Warrior]]s and [[Sith Marauder|Marauders]].

Around the same time, the Greater Javin was [[Javin sector/Legends|annexed]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and the planet was found under its protection, and the Ugnaughts developed Gentes and its moon into industrial worlds.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:BattleofGentes2.jpg|thumb|left|Separatist forces under General Grievous rounded up Ugnaughts for slave labor.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Gentes and its moon were occupied and suffered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]];<ref name="General Grievous 2">[[General Grievous 2|''General Grievous'' 2]]</ref> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="BGDate">The date of this story is established internally in relation to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Grievous [[Battle of Gentes|conquered]] the planet and rounded up many Ugnaughts as slaves. His forces also herded many Ugnaughts into a single building which was blown up with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] bombardment from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="General Grievous 2" /> Ugnaughts were also enslaved as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] policies.

In the years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Gentes was sparsely populated, with its former inhabitants either enslaved or on the Ugnaught-run Cloud City.<ref name="TEA" />
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Gentes in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], which is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
